title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
statement: You are given a string s. Find the length of the longest stretch of consecutive characters in s in which no character appears twice.

examples.explanation: "abc" is the longest stretch with no repeats.

tests.purpose: left pointer must never move backwards
a space is a character too
a repeat must not clear the whole window

optimal.approach_name: sliding window with last-seen index map

acceptable_suboptimal.note: Checking every start with a set is fine as a first idea.

hint_ladder.hint: Do you really need to recheck every substring from scratch?
Think about keeping a window of characters with no repeats, and how it changes as you move right.
When you see a repeat, the left side of the window should jump past the previous occurrence. You need to remember where each character was last seen.
Store the last index of each character; when the current character was last seen at or after left, set left to that index plus one.

common_mistakes.description: Moving the left pointer backwards when the repeated character is outside the current window.
Starting best at 1, which is wrong for the empty string.
Clearing the whole window on a repeat instead of moving left just past the earlier copy.
